basis: cost_model.py; 3,000 output tokens/call middle case; re-run after the Day 6 pilot with measured cost

plan_by_week_usd_at_3000_tokens.w9_w10_mmlu_pro: ~318 per 1,000 cases; size set at Week 9

rules.sampling: cheap models k=5; expensive and frontier k=1 (configs/sampling.json)
rules.stop_rule: After the pilot: upper 95% bound of SeqQA cost per case (mean + 1.96*sd/sqrt(n)) must be <= max_case_cost() with mmlu_min_cases (~$1.35 at 2026-11-15 prices; retries applied to SeqQA and MMLU-Pro). Otherwise stop and re-plan.
rules.mmlu_size: One subject-stratified ranked list of all 12,032 questions. At Week 9, run the longest prefix the remaining credit covers (max_mmlu_cases with measured cost and actual spend); minimum 2,000.
rules.optional_topup: Expensive/frontier SeqQA seeds 1-4 (~$525 at 3,000 tokens) only if W6-W8 needs them, from unallocated credit, and only if the model's version fingerprint is unchanged.
rules.cache: OFF for all measured runs (run_eval.py default).
rules.versions: Every run checked against configs/model_versions.json before and after; mismatch = refused / invalid. Never combine runs across versions.
rules.chunking: Chunk size = floor(3000*4/(k*latency)) from pilot latency per model; at most 3 chunks at once (shared 8-slot pool).
